author: Mark Williams
text: Awesome experience!  Mike was on time, professional, and courteous. The repair was made swiftly and neatly. I hope I don’t require plumbing services again, but if I do I’m calling Swift Creek Plumbing.  I will highly recommend to my friends and neighbors.

author: Joshua Brunton
text: Swift Creek was quick to respond and sent someone out for a quote promptly, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, that's where the positives ended for me. To replace a 50-gallon electric water heater, they quoted $2,800 — compared to $1,800 from two other local companies for the same job. That's over 50% more, and no one could point to anything (parts, warranty, timeline) that justified the gap. Ultimately I went with a different company. Responsiveness counts for a lot, but not enough to offset a price that far out of line with the market.

author: Jay Stevens
text:
We had an amazing experience! Their response time was incredibly fast, and the customer service was top-notch from start to finish.

What really stood out was their honesty and integrity. They took the time to walk my wife through everything step-by-step showing her there was no real plumbing issue. Instead of pushing unnecessary work, they helped her troubleshoot and Provided a solution we could do on our own.

That level of care, transparency, and professionalism is rare to find these days. It’s clear they truly value their customers and take pride in doing the right thing.

We will absolutely be using them again in the future and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy plumber!

author: Milton Woodson
text: My experience was very good, the you man who did the work was very knowledgeable and professional. I give a big thumbs up to Matthew! Thanks Matthew for taking care of my problem and thank you Swift Creek plumbing for having someone out in a timely manner.

author: Dennis Chapman
text: Good service, fair price.  Swift Creek Plumbing responded very quickly and got the work done fast with no mess. And the guys they sent were courteous. Recommended!
